what: Using {cuda.ml} for supervised ML tasks through {parsnip}
title: R Interface for the RAPIDS cuML Suite of Libraries
text: {cuda.ml} provides {parsnip} bindings supervised ML algorithms linear_reg, logistic_reg, multinom_reg, rand_forest, nearest_neighbor, svm_rbf, svm_poly, svm_linear. Regularized models follow tidymodels conventions penalty mixture. predictors need scaling, learn apply explicitly {recipes} step step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors()). following example shows {cuda.ml} can used {parsnip} engine build SVM classifier.
code: library(dplyr, warn.conflicts = FALSE) library(parsnip) library(cuda.ml) set.seed(11235)  train_inds <- iris %>%   mutate(ind = row_number()) %>%   group_by(Species) %>%   slice_sample(prop = 0.7)  train_data <- iris[train_inds$ind, ] test_data <- iris[-train_inds$ind, ]  model <- svm_rbf(mode = "classification", rbf_sigma = 10, cost = 50) %>%   set_engine("cuda.ml") %>%   fit(Species ~ ., data = train_data)  preds <- predict(model, test_data)  cat("Confusion matrix:\n\n") preds %>%   bind_cols(test_data %>% select(Species)) %>%   yardstick::conf_mat(truth = Species, estimate = .pred_class)

Optional arguments; currently unused. y numeric vector (regression) factor (classification) desired responses. alpha Positive multiplier penalty term. Use cuda_ml_ols() unpenalized linear model. text: breaking release targeting one backend: CUDA Toolkit 13.2.2, RAPIDS cuML nvForest 26.06, Treelite 4.7.0. Added Ubuntu 26.04 x86_64 backend distributed R-universe. package contains compiled cuda.ml backend approximately 1.6 GiB CUDA RAPIDS runtime. Added explicit cuda_ml_install() runtime preparation. Model operations longer download libraries implicitly; direct users run installer managed runtime absent. cuda_ml_runtime_audit() performs full content audit, cuda_ml_cache_clean() removes cuda.ml cache generations. Package loading cuda_ml_backend_info() silent side-effect free. inspect GPU, create cache, contact network, load native backend. CRAN checks use explicit network-free stub backend. Replaced removed cuML FIL interface current nvForest loading, prediction, model inspection, leaf-ID, per-tree, persistence APIs. Random-forest inference persistence now use nvForest backend. Corrected random-forest arguments: mtry now controls sampled predictors, sample_fraction controls sampled rows, trees defaults 100, seed forwarded cuML. Classification uses predict(..., type = "class") predict(..., type = "prob"). Added parsnip engines linear_reg(), logistic_reg(), multinom_reg() using customary penalty mixture arguments. Normalization longer emulated inside regularized linear models; use recipe preprocessing step scaling required. Removed interfaces supported backend implement: FIL, random projection, KNN IVFSQ, cuML log-level controls, has_cuML(), split cuML version queries. cuda_ml_backend_info() single backend metadata interface. Model persistence now requires explicit portable representation records package, schema, model ABI, backend identity. Unversioned incompatible states fail instead attempting migration. Added bundle::bundle() support models portable state. Added GPU-less fat-binary compilation compute capabilities 7.5, 8.0, 8.6, 8.9, 9.0, 10.0, 12.0, PTX forward compatibility 12.0. Removed native compatibility branches historical cuML releases implicit bootstrap fallbacks Python, pip, CMake, wheel layouts, CUDA architectures, missing local toolchains.
